name: The Misfit Kids
source:
Step in to the shoes of Ravenwood High's newest senior - you. Explore a colourful community, and experience the trials and tribulations of the best (and simultaneously worst) time of your life - school.

Balance school, friends and whatever else life decides to throw at you along the way, as you try to figure out who you really are, and the grandest mystery of all - what life is all about.

[from [url=https://aresinteractive.itch.io/the-misfit-kids]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
接替拉文伍德高中最新的高年级学生——你。探索丰富多彩的社区，体验人生中最美好的（同时也是最糟糕的）时光——学校的考验和磨难。

平衡学校、朋友和生活一路上给你带来的一切，当你试图弄清楚你到底是谁，以及最伟大的谜团——生活到底是什么。

[来自[url=https://aresinteractive.itch.io/the-misfit-kids]itch.io[/url]]
